digo: Mngweni mkulu; Mngwene mlume; Mtsonga nyomba (Mungweni)
digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Pakia (2005) App. VI; Maundu & Tengnäs 2005 (Mungweni)

teaser.en: One of its Digo names means 'arrow-shaft maker', and its straight sticks once flew from coastal hunters' bows.
teaser.sw: Mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo linamaanisha 'mtengeneza mipini ya mishale', na vijiti vyake vilivyonyooka zamani vilirushwa kutoka pinde za wawindaji wa pwani.
teaser.dg: Dzina ranjina ra Chidigo ra muhi hinyu, *mtsonga nyomba*, manage ni 'muhi wa kuhenda mabura ga mivi', na kare vigongovye vya kugoloka kala vinapigwa kpwa uha ni aindza a pwani.

summary.en: *Mngweni mkulu* is a liana or shrub of coastal forest with glossy leaves and edible fruits. It is the 'male' or large *mngweni*, valued for fruit, building twigs, arrow shafts and medicine.
summary.sw: *Mngweni mkulu* ni mtambaa au kichaka cha misitu ya pwani chenye majani yanayong'aa na matunda yanayoliwa. Ndiye *mngweni* 'dume' au mkubwa, anayethaminiwa kwa matunda, vitawi vya ujenzi, mipini ya mishale na dawa.
summary.dg: *Mngweni mkulu* ni mmea unaokpwera au chitsaka cha tsakani pwani, wenye makodza ganayong'ala na matunda ganayoriwa. Ni *mngweni* 'mlume' au mkulu, na una samani kpwa matundage, maphungo ga kudzengera, mabura ga mivi na dawa.

about.en:
*Mngweni mkulu* grows either as a liana or as an upright shrub. Its leaves are glossy, and the leaf stalks are covered in rusty-brown hairs, a good feature for telling it apart from its smaller-leaved partner, *mngwene*.

The flowers are yellow-green with the thick petals of the custard-apple family, and the fruits form clusters of small segments.
about.sw:
*Mngweni mkulu* hukua ama kama mtambaa ama kama kichaka kilichosimama wima. Majani yake yanang'aa, na vikonyo vya majani vimefunikwa kwa manyoya ya kahawia kama kutu, sifa nzuri ya kuutofautisha na mwenzake mwenye majani madogo zaidi, *mngwene*.

Maua yake ni ya rangi ya manjano-kijani yenye petali nene za familia ya mitopetope, na matunda hufanya vishada vya vipande vidogo.
about.dg:
*Mngweni mkulu* unamera dza mmea unaokpwera, au unaima chocho dza chitsaka. Makodzage ganang'ala, na milita ya makodza ifwinikpwa ni nyere za rangi ya dongo; ino ni alama nono ya kuutafwautisha na myawe wa makodza madide, *mngwene*.

Maruwage ni ga rangi ya chijani na mandano, na vipande vya maruwa ni viziho dza vira vya jamii ya *mbokwe*, na matundage ganakala mabunda ga vipande vidide.

where.en: *Mngweni mkulu* grows in coastal forest and bushland, climbing into the canopy or standing as a shrub on forest edges.
where.sw: *Mngweni mkulu* hukua katika misitu na vichaka vya pwani, ukipanda hadi kwenye kilele cha miti au ukisimama kama kichaka kando ya misitu.
where.dg: *Mngweni mkulu* unamera tsakani na weruni pwani, uchikpwera hadi dzulu ya mihi, au uchiima dza chitsaka kanda-kanda ya matsaka.

uses.en:
The fruits are eaten. The twigs are used in building, and straight sticks are cut for arrow shafts, which earned it the name *mtsonga nyomba*, 'arrow-shaft maker'.

The leaves are used medicinally.
uses.sw:
Matunda huliwa. Vitawi hutumika katika ujenzi, na vijiti vilivyonyooka hukatwa kuwa mipini ya mishale, jambo lililoupa jina *mtsonga nyomba*, 'mtengeneza mipini ya mishale'.

Majani hutumika kama dawa.
uses.dg:
Matundage nkuriwa. Maphungoge nkuhumirwa kudzengera, na vigongo vya kugoloka nkukatwa kuhenda mabura ga mivi; ndiyo sababu unaihwa *mtsonga nyomba*, 'muhi wa kuhenda mabura ga mivi'.

Makodzage nkuhumirwa dza dawa.

culture.en: This is the 'male' or large *mngweni*, paired with *mngwene*, the 'female' or small one with smaller leaves.
culture.sw: Huyu ndiye *mngweni* 'dume' au mkubwa, akiwa jozi na *mngwene*, 'jike' au mdogo mwenye majani madogo zaidi.
culture.dg: Hinyu ni *mngweni* 'mlume' au mkulu. Myawe ni *mngwene*, *mngweni* 'mchetu' au mdide, ambao makodzage ni madide.

names.en: Digo: *mngweni mkulu* ('large *mngweni*'), also *mngwene mlume* ('male *mngwene*') and *mtsonga nyomba*, 'arrow-shaft maker'. Another source records the Digo name *mungweni*. Swahili: *mganda simba*. Giriama: *mudzala*. Scientists call it *Uvaria lucida*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mngweni mkulu* ('*mngweni* mkubwa'), pia *mngwene mlume* ('*mngwene* dume') na *mtsonga nyomba*, 'mtengeneza mipini ya mishale'. Chanzo kingine kinarekodi jina la Kidigo *mungweni*. Kiswahili: *mganda simba*. Kigiriama: *mudzala*. Wanasayansi huuita *Uvaria lucida*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mngweni mkulu* ('*mngweni* mkulu'), piya *mngwene mlume* ('*mngwene* mlume') na *mtsonga nyomba*, 'muhi wa kuhenda mabura ga mivi'. Chitabu chanjina chinaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mungweni*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mganda simba*. Kpwa Chigiryama ni *mudzala*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Uvaria lucida*.

reason.en: Source of arrow poison and spear shafts
reason.sw: Chanzo cha sumu ya mishale na mipini ya mikuki
reason.dg: Kula kpwakpwe nkuphahikana sumu ya mivi na mabura ga mafumo

reason.en: Fellow member of the custard-apple family
reason.sw: Mwanafamilia mwenzake wa familia ya mitopetope

reason.en: Forest relative in the custard-apple family
reason.sw: Ndugu wa msituni katika familia ya mitopetope
reason.dg: Muhi wa tsakani wa jamii ya *mbokwe*
